scope: Read-only cross-session retained-source hash, count, baseline-preservation and cleanup-evidence audit. No source replay, network, tests, signals, browser, new scratch or tracked edits.

baseline.canonicalOrdering: configurationId sorted; baseline filtered relative order unchanged
baseline.spentOrdering: complete baseline exact prefix; subsequent session additions append

actualEventEvidence.mergeRule: Exact pinned source membership; merge by (attempt, phase) only when overlapping raw rows are byte-identical. No synthesized events or source requests.

cleanup.originalFailureCause: unresolved: original finalizer did not retain the failing ps snapshot or distinguish live membership from an uncertain snapshot
cleanup.diagnosticDefectStatus: open; parent owns linked backlog Bug capture; no runtime repair made
cleanup.scopeLimit: The two later snapshots establish absence at their capture times. They cannot establish the historical cause of the original false/uncertain group-absence result.

unknowns: Historical cause of original finalizer group-absence failure remains unresolved; Medium diagnostic gap stays open for parent-linked Bug capture.
Retained-source audit does not establish enrichment, corpus publication/application integration, whole scheme-model-line breadth or full story acceptance.
No production-probe results are assessed here; parent owns the active probe.
